title: Wemby ties history and Sean still loses
intro: Victor Wembanyama scored 201 on Nov 4, tied with Luka's 201 from 2022 for the second biggest game in league history, behind only Embiid's 206. Sean lost anyway, by 16. Max put up 2,652.5, the new best score of the season, and buried Dean by 464.5. And for the second week in a row, Koren lost to a team starting a player Koren had let go. Three teams are still unbeaten: Matt W, Max and Ben.

teams.Matt W: 3-0 and 23-4 against the whole league. Giannis had 376 and Jaylen Brown 326.5, and that was plenty to beat Matt G by 165.5 and take the battle of the Matts. Not a clean week, though: 167 left on the bench, including Jeremiah Fears sitting for 58.5. Immanuel Quickley managed 64.5 in two starts. Next is Ben, also 3-0, and Matt W leads that series 11-9.
teams.Max: The best score of the season, 2,652.5, a 9-0 week against the league, and a 464.5-point beating of Dean for a share of first. Flagg had 307.5 and Maxey 285, and Ayo Dosunmu added 278.5. That is 476.5 in two weeks from the guy Ben dropped. Max also led the league with 47 starter games. Kel'el Ware's 32 in two starts is the only blemish.
teams.Ben: 3-0, but barely. Ben beat Sean by 16 with the second best score of the week, and Sean would have won with a better lineup. Jokic had 334, Reaves 292.5 and Keyonte George 256.5, and Saddiq Bey paid off with 102 as a pickup. Daniel Gafford got streamed for 43.5 in two games. Matt W is next, with both teams unbeaten.
teams.Dean: Last week Dean set a perfect lineup every day. This week Dean had the lowest score in the league, went 0-9 against everyone and lost to Max by 464.5. Steph had 274 and Cade 257.5, but Jarrett Allen gave him 52 in three games and Paul Reed sat on the bench for 92.5. Still 2-1. Karan is next, and Karan won their last meeting in the 2025-26 playoffs.
teams.Karan: Coach of the week with a perfect lineup every day, and a 98-point loss to Sammy anyway. Luka had 365.5, Darius Acuff Jr. 315 and Walker Kessler 297. Brandon Miller went from 345.5 last week to 94 in three games. Karan had the best single day of the week, 702 on Monday, and was 1-2 by Sunday.
teams.Sammy: Beat Karan by 98 to get to 2-1. Bam had 314, Miles Bridges 311.5 and Dyson Daniels 281.5. The bust watch belongs to Sammy: Jalen Johnson, a first-round pick, averaged 41.3 a game. Cam Johnson sat on the bench for 63. Koren is next, and Koren leads the series 10-7.
teams.Koren: 0-3, and the unluckiest team in the league, 1.6 wins short of what the scoring says. Koren lost to Mack by 28.5. Aaron Wiggins, picked up and let go by Koren in week 2, scored 119 for Mack. Jayson Tatum scored 105.5 on Nov 6 and none of it counted. Michael Porter Jr. had 247.5 and Darryn Peterson 246.5, and Zaccharie Risacher got cut after 37.5 in two starts.
teams.Mack: First win of the season, and the luckiest win of the week. Mack scored 2,222, eighth in the league, and beat Koren by 28.5. That came despite leaving 221 on the bench, the most of anyone, with CJ McCollum sitting for 139. Donovan Mitchell had 308.5, Okongwu 293 and Clingan 272, and Aaron Wiggins delivered 119 as a pickup. Mack also traded castoffs with Koren: Brook Lopez went the other way.
teams.Sean: Wembanyama scored 447 this week, including the 201, which is now the best single game Sean has had in this league. Kyshawn George, dropped by Max, gave him 303.5 as the waiver hero of the week, and Devin Booker woke up with 279.5. Sean scored 2,508.5, third in the league, and lost to Ben by 16. With the best possible lineup Sean scores 2,617 and wins; Davion Mitchell sat for 123.5. 0-3.
teams.Matt G: 0-3 and last in the power rankings, down two spots. SGA had 379.5 and Deni Avdija 256.5, but the Matts game went to Matt W by 165.5. Zach Edey scored 97.5 on the bench and Andrew Wiggins had 47 in two starts. Zero moves all week. Mack is next, and Mack leads the series 7-5.

preview: Matt W and Ben, both 3-0, meet with Matt W up 11-9 all-time. Max gets Sean, which has gone Max's way 14 times out of 19. Koren tries for a first win against Sammy, and Matt G against Mack.
